parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: Override
parameters.description: Whether to overwrite. Value range: - true: Overwrite. - false: Do not overwrite.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas create-customized-dict --source-ip 106.11.43.000 --lang zh --override false --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas CreateCustomizedDict --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '106.11.43.000' --Lang zh --Override false
